title: amaracarpus acuminatus subsp. pullei
intro: Amaracarpus acuminatus subsp. pullei, commonly known as Pulley Amaracarpus, is a species of plant in the family Rubiaceae, native to Indonesia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as lowering blood pressure and acting as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Pulley Amaracarpus include its potential to reduce fever, improve digestion, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant are rich in flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
